r0020: I.  THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE
r0021: 5.  The applicant was born in 1969. When the application was lodged, he was detained in Nazilli Prison in Aydın.
r0022: 6.  On 17 January 1997 he was arrested by the police on suspicion of membership of an illegal organisation, namely the PKK.
r0023: 7.  On 31 January 1997 he was brought before the substitute judge at the Izmir State Security Court (*cour de sûreté de l'Etat d'Izmir*), who ordered his pre-trial detention.
r0024: 8.  On 20 March 1997 the public prosecutor at the State Security Court (*cour de sûreté de l'Etat*) sought the application of Article 168 of the Criminal Code (*code pénal*) for membership of the PKK.
r0025: 9.  On 29 December 1997 the State Security Court (*cour de sûreté de l'Etat*), composed of two civilian judges and a military judge, found the applicant guilty of the offences with which he had been charged and sentenced him to eighteen years and nine months' imprisonment. In its judgment, the court noted that the applicant had admitted the offences in question during the preliminary investigation and before the public prosecutor and the substitute judge who had taken his statements, and that the statements of the co-accused and other additional evidence confirmed the version of events set out in the indictment.
r0026: 10.  In a judgment of 4 March 1999, delivered on 17 March 1999, the Court of Cassation (*Cour de cassation*) upheld the impugned judgment.
r0027: II.  RELEVANT DOMESTIC LAW AND PRACTICE
r0028: 11.  The relevant domestic law and practice are described in the judgments in Özel v. Turkey (no. 42739/98, §§ 20-21, 7 November 2002) and Özdemir v. Turkey (no. 59659/00, §§ 21-22, 6 February 2003).
r0029: 12.  Article 327 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (*code de procédure pénale*) lists the situations in which “a case that has been concluded by a final judgment may be retried in favour of the convicted person”.
